title: The Hidden Reason You Undercharge
hook: You might not be undercharging because you're modest.
caption:
Sometimes the lower price is not about strategy. It is about safety.

You know your work is valuable. But when it is time to name the price, something in you wants to make the number smaller.

Because a lower price can feel like lower risk: less chance of rejection, judgment, or hearing that you're too expensive.

Before changing your pricing strategy, notice what happens in your body when you imagine saying your real price.

The goal is not to force yourself to charge more.

It is to understand what you are protecting yourself from.
